description: Reactions extracted from AiZynthFinder's USPTO template library that are absent from Hartenfeller and eXplore catalogs. These cover common transformations like halogenation that rule-based catalogs lack.

reactions.name: aromatic_bromination
reactions.notes: Aromatic bromination (e.g. NBS, Br2). Note: Regioselectivity is not predicted by this rule-based model; results should be verified for site-selectivity.
